annotation.title_clean: HOUSE LAUNCHES BIPARTISAN TASK FORCE ON ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE
annotation.title_en: House Launches Bipartisan Task Force on Artificial Intelligence
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Office of Rep. Ted Lieu / U.S. House of Representatives (Speaker Johnson and Leader Jeffries announcement)
annotation.venue: Office of Rep. Ted Lieu website
annotation.summary_en: Press release announcing the bipartisan House Task Force on AI, led by Reps. Obernolte and Lieu with twelve members appointed by each party leader. It will produce a report with guiding principles and policy proposals balancing US AI leadership and innovation with appropriate guardrails.
key_provisions_or_claims: Establishes a bipartisan House Task Force on AI with 24 members
Chair Obernolte and Co-Chair Lieu lead the effort
Task Force to produce a comprehensive report with guiding principles and bipartisan policy proposals
Aims to maintain US AI leadership while considering guardrails against threats
